help.goal: Slide numbered tiles together to build bigger ones. Reach the 2048 tile before the board fills up.
steps: Swipe the board up, down, left or right.
Every tile slides that way and equal neighbours merge into one.
A new 2 or 4 appears after each swipe that moved something.
Tap New game to start over, then tap again to confirm.
notes: A tile born from a merge cannot merge again in the same swipe.
A swipe that changes nothing is ignored and gives you no new tile.
Reaching 2048 shows a banner but you may keep playing for a higher score.
